one_line: Fragment-era Deccan nobles holding together the legacy of the Satavahanas amid rising Abhira, Ikshvaku and Chutu powers.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but athletic build with the poised bearing of a regional noble and commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, long dark brows, and a small vertical tilak in pale red; default expression is calm, alert and slightly serious, as if weighing political options.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted in the center, drawn back into a high, smooth braided topknot (kaparda-like knot) at the rear crown, with the braid wrapped in a narrow red cloth strip; no crown, but a simple gold circlet band sits low on the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off‑white cotton tunic with elbow-length sleeves and a round neck, edged with narrow red borders, over which is draped a saffron‑orange cotton uttariya (shawl) wrapped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the waist; a deep green cotton dhoti, pleated neatly and tied at the front, falls to the ankles with a thin gold border at the hem; on his feet are simple brown leather sandals with toe loops; jewellery is subdued yet noble—broad flat gold necklace with a central disc, a pair of medium gold ear‑rings shaped like small hoops, two thin gold armlets on the upper arms, and a single beaded bracelet on the right wrist.
appearance.signature: A long iron straight sword with a simple leaf-shaped blade and plain crossguard, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard hanging from a cloth belt at his left hip, its wooden hilt wrapped in dark red cord.

ref_desc: A medium-brown Deccan noble in an off‑white tunic, saffron‑orange shawl, deep green ankle‑length dhoti and brown sandals, with black hair in a braided topknot, gold circlet and simple jewellery, carrying a leaf-bladed straight sword in a brown scabbard, in a gold‑green‑saffron palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Deccan noble from the Satavahana successor era: a medium-brown man in his late 20s with an oval face, straight nose, sharp jaw, long dark brows, and a small pale red vertical tilak, wearing an off‑white knee-length cotton tunic with red edging, a saffron‑orange shawl (uttariya) wrapped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the waist, a deep green pleated dhoti reaching the ankles with a thin gold border, and simple brown leather sandals; his thick black hair is parted in the center and pulled into a smooth braided topknot at the rear crown wrapped with a narrow red cloth strip, and he wears a plain gold circlet low on the forehead, a flat gold necklace with a central disc, small gold hoop earrings, thin upper-arm armlets and a single beaded wrist bracelet; at his left hip hangs a long, leaf-bladed straight iron sword in a brown leather scabbard with a wooden hilt wrapped in dark red cord; show him from multiple angles to emphasize the consistent off‑white, saffron‑orange, deep green, brown and gold colour scheme and the exact hair, face, clothing details and sword placement.
